phase: V2 PHASE 3: STRUCTURAL INTERDEPENDENCE (SHARED GAME ENVIRONMENT + JOINT MINUTES + OPPORTUNITY REDISTRIBUTION)
pre_freeze_development_disclosure: Design prototypes before this freeze used: team-game data 2013-14..2024-25 for the environment OLS shape (R2 / residual SDs); Phase 1B OOS rows of 2023-24 and 2024-25 for GLM coefficient magnitudes / stability; minutes of a 2,000-team-game subset of 2024-25 for the allocator form (kappa in {0, 0.75, 1}, anchored vs not). No Phase 3 candidate (S1..S4) was scored on any season; nothing of 2025-26 was inspected. kappa = 1 is declared as Phase 1B's own minutes SD, not tuned.

inputs.team_data: Stage 3 lockbox store feat.team_features (pregame) + lab.team_game_labels (training labels)

candidate_ladder.S0: Phase 2 benchmark: Phase 1B marginals + J2 (the Phase 2 fit of the same chronology)
candidate_ladder.S1: S0 + shared game environment: log mu += gamma_s . (pace_dev, own_eff_dev, opp_eff_dev); pregame mean deviations + simulated shared shocks; Phase 1B dispersion; Phase 2 J2 copula
candidate_ladder.S2: S1 + joint constrained minutes (anchored logit-shift allocation under the base P(play) scenario) + c_s + beta_s log(max(M,1)/min_mu)
candidate_ladder.S3: S2 + opportunity redistribution: + theta_s log(U_ref,f / U_f) for the stat's family f
candidate_ladder.S4: S3 + refitted conditional dispersion + refitted residual J2 (same architecture) + mean anchor alpha

retrospective_confirmation.runs: exactly once; the selection is not changed by it

chronology.true_OOS_structural_residuals: season F residuals use structural parameters fitted through F-1 (F2024 uses parameters from F2023 = 2022-23 Phase 1B OOS rows)

player: Phase 1B min_mu, min_sigma, {stat}_mu (per-minute family rates = mu / min_mu), {stat}_phi
never_inputs: sportsbook spread / total / moneyline / prop lines
target-game realized pace, efficiency, minutes, participation (training labels only)

shared_game_variables.expected_pace: OLS of realized log(poss * 40 / game_minutes) on [1, own log pace, opp log pace, own log off eff, opp log def eff, home, away]; team pace / efficiency = prior-game values shrunk toward the prior season (efficiency) or the training league mean with 4 / 6 pseudo-games; game-level expectation = mean of the two team predictions
shared_game_variables.expected_efficiency: same design for realized log(points / possession) per team
shared_game_variables.shocks: shared game pace eps_g ~ N(0, sd_pace) (game-level residual SD); team efficiency (eps_0, eps_1) ~ BVN(0, sd_eff, rho_eff) (training residuals)
shared_game_variables.duration: D = 40 + 5 K, K from the training overtime frequencies; one duration per draw for both teams

minutes_allocation.method: anchored logit-shift: s_i = sigmoid(a_i + kappa sd_i xi_i + delta_d), sum_active s = 5, M_i = 5 D s_i / sum s (exact team total, 0 <= M <= D, inactive 0); a_i = logit(min_mu/40) calibrated (6 fixed-point steps on the first 2000 draws) so E[M_i | i active] = min_mu_i under the base scenario; sd_i = min(min_sigma / (40 p (1 - p)), 3); kappa = 1 (declared)
minutes_allocation.players: every rostered candidate of the team (bench included)

opportunity_families.budget_share: U_f = sum_active M_j rate_jf; share_i = M_i rate_if / U_f; team budget B_f = U_ref^theta U_f^(1 - theta); U_ref = base-scenario expectation of U_f (training: team-season mean)

conditional_mean_glm.fit: Poisson pseudo-likelihood with offset log mu_1B, ridge 1e-06 x n on non-intercept terms, per stat, on Phase 1B OOS rows 2022-23..T given the realized state

availability_policy.evaluation_scenario: BASE_PPLAY: every candidate other than the scored player is active with its pregame Phase 1B P(play); a scored player's single-player quantities are conditional on him playing (forced active in the same draw)
availability_policy.historical_overrides: none: no historical pregame status source exists (availability.events = 0 rows); zero minutes is never treated as a known OUT
availability_policy.production_interface: ACTIVE 1, OUT 0, EXPECTED_ACTIVE max(model, 0.9), QUESTIONABLE / UNCERTAIN supplied probability (default 0.5), none -> P(play); validated by invariants only (prospective validation in 2026-27)

dispersion_refit_policy: S1-S3 keep the Phase 1B dispersion; S4: one phi per stat by method of moments on true-OOS structural residuals given the realized state; Phase 1B families kept (STL stays NB, TOV stays Poisson)
residual_dependence_policy: S1-S3 use the Phase 2 J2 of the same chronology; S4 refits the same J2 architecture (dependence.fit, MID) on the conditional PMFs of the true-OOS structural residual basis

monte_carlo_policy.rule: if a decisive ES / VS_BAL interval bound of the selection lies within 3 MC SE of zero, the affected comparison is rerun with 50,000 draws
monte_carlo_policy.marginals: Rao-Blackwellized: the predictive PMF is the mixture of conditional PMFs over the draws (S0 exact)
monte_carlo_policy.seeds: J2 latent bank BLAKE2b(20263|game) as Phase 2 (common across arms); structural streams BLAKE2b(20265|stream|game)

metrics.participation: Brier / log loss / calibration of the unchanged P(play)
metrics.diagnostic_not_objective: latent spread ratio lam per role (Phase 2 1.39 / 1.28 / 1.05)

layer_gates.S1_SHARED_GAME_ENVIRONMENT: ACCEPT iff one of ES, VS_SHARED, EVENT_BRIER_SHARED improves vs S0 (95% CI upper < 0) and MEAN_MSE_SCALED is not significantly worse
layer_gates.S2_JOINT_MINUTES: ACCEPT iff 0 team-minutes violations, MIN_CRPS not significantly worse than Phase 1B (S1), and one of MIN_CRPS, MARG_LOG on ROTATION_OR_BENCH cells, ES improves vs S1
layer_gates.S3_OPPORTUNITY_REDISTRIBUTION: ACCEPT iff MEAN_MSE_SCALED or MARG_LOG improves vs S2 and neither is significantly worse

selection_rule.alpha: alpha* = argmin MARG_LOG over S4(0.5), S4(1.0) on 2024-25 (tie -> 1.0)
selection_rule.rejected_layer: if any layer is rejected, the S4 candidate is rebuilt from the accepted layers only (GLM refit on those terms, S4 components refit) and evaluated once more on 2024-25

acceptance_vs_S0.A1: MARG_LOG improves (CI upper < 0), or ROTATION_OR_BENCH MARG_LOG improves (CI upper < 0) with aggregate delta <= +0.001 nats
acceptance_vs_S0.A2: no stat with MARG_LOG delta > +0.002 nats and CI lower > 0
acceptance_vs_S0.A3: TEAM_MINUTES_CONSTRAINT_VIOLATIONS = 0 and MIN_CRPS not significantly worse than Phase 1B
acceptance_vs_S0.A4: PTS lam for BENCH_9PLUS and ROTATION_6_8 both closer to 1 (|log lam|) than S0
acceptance_vs_S0.A5: ES and VS_BAL not significantly worse than S0
acceptance_vs_S0.A6: TM_SCORER_SCORER (both top scorers over): Brier below S0 and |observed - mean predicted| smaller

selection_rule.selected: the S4 candidate (alpha*) if every acceptance condition holds; otherwise S0 (Phase 2 J2 kept; Phase 3 not promoted)

accounting_tests: team minutes = 5 D (|diff| <= 1e-9) in every team draw
shares >= 0 and sum to 1 per family
constraints are built into generation (no post-hoc repair)
